_comment: CME micro contract specifications — dollars per one point of price movement. The live tracker recorded pnl_usd as (exit - entry) x 1, i.e. it treated every instrument as $1 per point, so the live P&L history understated the real dollar result by 2x on MNQ and up to 100x on GC.
_risk_budget_note: The account's daily loss envelope. 'max_stop_points' is how many points of stop distance a single contract can carry before the whole $100 is at risk: $100 / dollars per point.
